svg.title: Nib Atlas access denied postal impression
svg.desc: Vintage Nib Atlas postal impression. Original founder-supplied nib half above, globe half below, and editable ACCESS DENIED lettering. Logo source nib-atlas-symbol-primary.svg, SHA-256 50b0256b97a19bdb1d12c8ce03fbc22c93f519e3e8b3999725db505f4eafe920.
